claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year FHA loan rates generally hover in the high-5% to mid-6% range.
As of late March 2026, many lenders offer 30-year FHA loan rates around 5.8%–6.1% for qualified borrowers.
FHA loans require a 3.5% down payment for credit scores of 580 or higher.
In March 2026, 30-Year Fixed FHA rates often sit between 5.84% and 6.47%.
In March 2026, 30-Year Fixed FHA APRs are higher due to mortgage insurance premiums.
In March 2026, 15-Year Fixed FHA rates range closer to 5.49%–5.99%.
In March 2026, 30-year FHA refinance rates are around 5.88%–5.99%.
FHA loans generally require a minimum credit score of 580 for a 3.5% down payment.
Some lenders allow lower credit scores for FHA loans with a 10% down payment.
FHA loans require an upfront mortgage insurance premium of 1.75%.
FHA loans require an annual mortgage insurance premium of 0.55% paid monthly.
FHA loan limits vary by county.
